title: Remember until the mind stops sprinting
summary: Peace follows remembrance when the mind stops sprinting ahead. Quiet the spiral before it sounds like wisdom.
takeaway: Quiet the spiral before it sounds like wisdom.
lifeApplication: Before solving the whole future, name what care is already present in this room today.

source.shortMeaning: Peace follows remembrance when the mind stops sprinting ahead.
